# Implementation Evidence — referral-home

> Required coding gate. Do not implement from `implementation-spec.md` alone.
> Gate semantics: Token evidence cannot be `<missing>` in a generated/quality-passing gate. Structured layouts need sub-item token evidence, not only container tokens. Snapshot evidence may use `<missing>` / `<待 P15 回填>` only as a handoff risk marker before P15 backfill or after explicit P15 skip/audit.
> Incomplete semantics: missing module-level token evidence, unresolved structured layout token gaps, missing Snapshot evidence field, or missing Coding Gate Checklist makes this gate `incomplete` unless explicitly skipped with audit.
> Generated by figma-emit-spec@0.1.0 at 2026-05-20T17:00:00+08:00

## Required Files Before Coding
| Evidence Type | File | Must Read | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Requirement | clarified-requirement.md | yes | scope / copy / constraints |
| UI Structure | ui-understanding.md | yes | layout, control shape, visible labels, non-implementation notes |
| API Mapping | api-mapping.md | yes | endpoint and field source |
| Component Mapping | component-mapping.md | yes | UI slot to API binding |
| Design Tokens | design-token-patch.md | yes | module-level dimensions, spacing, colors, radius, typography, states |
| Implementation Spec | implementation-spec.md | yes | behavior, state, integration constraints |
| Snapshot | snapshots/default.png | when present | visual baseline validation |

## Evidence by Module

- Token evidence: `design-token-patch.md#diamondpreviewcard`; key tokens: `borderRadius=12px`, `padding=12px 16px`, `background=#FFFFFF`, `titleFontSize=14px`, `valueFontSize=24px`, `valueFontWeight=Semi Bold`, `valueColor=#FF6A3D`, `valueLabel=钻石数量`
- Behavior/API evidence: `implementation-spec.md#diamondpreviewcard` + `api-mapping.md#field-mapping`
- Snapshot evidence: `snapshots/default.png` (handoff risk until P15 verifies metadata)
- Do not implement from assumption:
  - 不要把 C2 推测的 "钻石余额" 当作最终可见 label；Phase D 真实 characters 已校正为 "钻石数量"。
  - 不要实现 trend badge；该项在 Phase A open question 中标记为 deferred。
